articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Stephanie Campbell)
articles.description: Your past shapes who you are as a designer, no matter where your career began or how unexpected your career path may have been. articles.description: Internationalization isn’t just translation. It’s about formatting dates, pluralizing words, sorting names, and more, all according to specific locales. articles.title: The Power Of The Intl API: A Definitive Guide To Browser-Native Internationalization

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Joas Pambou)
articles.description: Design systems are more than style guides: they’re made up of workflows, tokens, components, and documentation — all the stuff teams rely on to build consistent products. articles.title: Automating Design Systems: Tips And Resources For Getting Started
